title: Bridgeport Art Center

services.name: Creative Classes
services.desc: Welcome to the Riverview Workshops at the Bridgeport Art Center - a collective, membership-based workspace designed for urban makers. Our community includes woodworkers, glass artists, metal craftspeople, and other hands-on creators who need room to experiment, build, and grow. City living has its advantages, but spacious studios are rarely one of them. Riverview Workshops provides space, tools, and collaborative environment makers need to thrive.
